results.description:
Fuelio is a simple, easy-to-use fuel tracker for your mileage, fuel consumption, and car expenses. Just log your odometer reading and how much fuel you bought at each fill-up, and Fuelio calculates your fuel economy and keeps a full fuel log, with clear charts and statistics for one car or a small fleet.

Find nearby gas stations and compare gas prices right from CarPlay, so you always know where to refuel for less. Glance at your dashboard from a Home Screen widget, or report a missing or incorrect gas station from the app.

Generate a Seller's report or a Custom report in a few taps, handy when selling a car or filing an expense claim.

Fuelio Premium turns Fuelio into a complete expense tracker for your car, covering maintenance, insurance, repairs, parking, tolls, car washes, and more. It also unlocks maintenance reminders, camera receipt scanning that works instantly on your device, even offline, weather logging on fill-ups, and three deeper report types: Annual Summary, Fuel Efficiency, and Maintenance.

Supports every major fuel type — Gasoline, Diesel, Electric, LPG, CNG, Ethanol — including bi-fuel vehicles with two tanks. Distance, volume, and consumption units are available for every region.

Add as many vehicles as you want, each with its own units, and import or export your data as CSV any time.

Your data stays on your device, with optional automatic iCloud Drive backup. No account required, no ads.

Fuel prices are provided by users and third-party sources (or official government providers in some countries) and may not reflect current station rates. We are not responsible for their accuracy or availability.

Terms of use: https://fuel.io/termsofuse.html

results.description:
PumpTally makes it effortless to track what you spend at the pump -- and actually understand where your money goes.

Just enter any two numbers (price, amount, or total) and PumpTally instantly calculates the third. One tap to save, and you're done. It takes less time than the receipt printing.

KNOW YOUR NUMBERS
See your miles per gallon (or liters per 100 km), total spending, cost per mile, and more -- all on a clean, beautiful dashboard. Spot trends over time with interactive charts that show how your efficiency and fuel prices change from fill-up to fill-up.

TRACK EVERY VEHICLE YOU OWN
Whether it's a daily commuter, a weekend truck, or the family SUV, each vehicle gets its own dashboard, history, and charts. Switch between miles and kilometers on a per-vehicle basis -- PumpTally converts everything for you.

YOUR DATA, YOUR WAY
Turn on iCloud sync and your records follow you across every iPhone and iPad. Everything is stored privately in your personal iCloud -- no accounts to create, no data shared with anyone. Export to CSV anytime if you want a spreadsheet backup.

THOUGHTFULLY DESIGNED
- Smart input fields that feel natural to use
- Automatic efficiency calculations for every fill-up
- Support for partial fills and missed recordings
- Notes on any entry for gas station names, road trips, or reminders
- Charts that stay readable whether you have 10 records or 1,000

PumpTally is free, private, and built for people who like knowing their numbers.

For personal use and for professionals who use their vehicle for work (Uber, taxi, Cabify, 99, Didi)

• FOR CORPORATE USE:
Drivvo is a system for managing vehicle fleets, which gives the manager total control over vehicles and drivers. Track all refueling, expenses and services, schedule all appointments for each vehicle and driver.

Now you can fully manage your fleet, tracking Refuelings, Expenses, Maintenance (preventive and corrective), Income, Routes, Checklists and Reminders.

• REFUELING
Fuel control is the most important part of managing your vehicle. With the application, you can fill in the refueling data in real time, giving more agility to the management.
The resource allows you to easily identify if there is a problem with the vehicle and if there is a need for maintenance.

• CHARGING FOR ELECTRIC AND HYBRID VEHICLES
Electric and hybrid vehicles are covered too: log charges, track consumption in mi/kWh, and manage energy costs — all in one app.

• CHECKLIST
Create custom forms to run inspections on your vehicles, ensuring your vehicle is roadworthy. This reduces the risk of mechanical problems in remote or unfamiliar locations.
The vehicle checklist helps you identify and fix safety issues before they become dangerous. Items such as brakes, tires, lights and seat belts can be checked regularly to ensure the vehicle is in safe operating condition.

• EXPENSE
Drivvo allows you to have total control over your vehicle's expenses, registering taxes, insurance, fines, parking, among other expenses.

• SERVICE
Oil changes, brake checks, tire changes, filters, air conditioning cleaning. All these services can be easily viewed in the app.

• INCOME
Drivvo also makes it possible to record income, to make life easier for drivers who use their vehicle as a work tool, such as transport app drivers, for example.

• ROUTE
Keep a record of all trips that are made on a day-to-day basis.
If you use your vehicle for work and are paid per kilometer driven, Drivvo helps you organize and calculate your travel reimbursements.
It makes it easier for the fleet manager to identify the driver who was behind the wheel.

• REMINDER
Having scheduled preventive maintenance is another fundamental activity in managing your vehicle.
With the help of the app, you can set reminders to track regular services such as oil changes, tire replacements, inspections and tune-ups — scheduled by mileage or date.

Drivvo is a vehicle fleet management system that gives the fleet manager full control over vehicle and driver data.

Wherever you go, GasBuddy® helps you fuel up for less while rewarding you with savings that go beyond the pump. With over 100 million downloads and 25 years of saving drivers more on fuel, the GasBuddy app is a trusted source for value-seeking drivers, helping you save the most on every fill-up while you shop, snap, and game your way to bigger savings. 

 

Find the Best Gas Prices at Any Station 

 

Our community is powered by drivers like you! We rely on GasBuddies to find and report gas prices. Search for any type of fuel and sort by price, location, or amenities like restrooms, restaurants, and more. When you report a price or review a station, you help other drivers find the best places to fuel up. That makes planning road trips and sticking to a budget much easier. 

 

GasBuddy Rewards: Snap & game your way to more savings! 

 

Saving is a destination. Where will you go today? Get rewarded with points for snapping receipts, playing games, and finding deals as part of your daily routine. Points can be redeemed in the app for cents-per-gallon discounts at the pump or for digital cards from top retailers. Think of GasBuddy Rewards points as the fuel for your next savings adventure. In addition, Pay with GasBuddy+™ members and Premium members can earn even more points through special offers and promotions. 

 


Activate a Flash Deal before filling up to save even more at the pump! 

 

Before every fill-up, find a station with a Flash Deal banner and tap to activate the additional pump savings. Track your fuel usage and stay up to date on vehicle recalls for added safety. You can also map road trips to view gas prices along your route. 

 

Not a Pay with GasBuddy+™ member? You can still earn up to 250 points/gal on activated Flash Deals when you fill up and upload your receipt. 

 

Save more at the pump with Pay with GasBuddy+™ 

 

Unlock greater savings for life's journeys. Members enjoy everyday fuel savings of at least 3¢/gal* guaranteed, and 5¢/gal* at select stations, with potential savings up to 33¢/gal* with an activated Flash Deal. Pay at the pump or inside the convenience store at stations nationwide, everywhere Mastercard® is accepted. PLUS, earn additional fuel savings on non-fuel purchases when you shop inside the convenience store. 

 

*Terms apply. Visit http://www.gasbuddy.com/pay for more information. 

 

The Pay with GasBuddy+™ card is issued by Fifth Third Bank, National Association, Member FDIC, pursuant to license by Mastercard International. Mastercard and the circles design are registered trademarks of Mastercard International Incorporated. See cardholder agreement for more information.
